text.text: Plan a study, schedule sessions, and log what you learn. Insights link back to the sessions that show them, so anyone can check the evidence.
The people who give you an hour are the most valuable thing this repository holds. Treat them as such.
Always confirm consent before the first session.
Offer the thank-you gift when the session ends, not later.
Wait at least eight weeks before asking the same person again.
No-shows happen. Reschedule once, then move on.

Recruit across segments, not just the friendliest customers. A study of eight happy regulars teaches you how regulars behave; the newcomers who gave up in week one are where the learning is. Check the Segment column before you invite and aim for a spread.
Add each person once and link every session to that row.
Tick Consent given only after you have it in writing or on the recording.
If someone withdraws, remove their name and recording link but keep the insight, worded without them.
